theme_concept.name: PaisaBook
theme_concept.vibe: Trustworthy, approachable, warm. Specifically tailored for Indian personal finance context (Hinglish copy support).

borders.note: Use 1px subtle borders for dashboard cards to maintain the 'Data-Heavy' bento feel without overwhelming shadows.

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Solid background (#FFFFFF), 1px subtle border, no heavy shadow by default.
surfaces.glassmorphism: Avoid in data tables to prevent visual refraction. Use flat solid surfaces for clarity.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Bento style). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 for card internal padding (e.g., p-6 for summary widgets).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align text, labels, and forms. Center-align empty states and main hero text on login.

components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Must have distinct hover state and transition.
components_strategy.cards: Avoid default heavy shadow cards. Stick to clean rectangles with subtle borders (border-[#E7E5DF]).
components_strategy.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI Input, Select. Labels should be left-aligned and use 'tiny_labels' styling.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn Recharts. Use brand.accent_income (#4A7C59) and brand.accent_expense (#D96C52) for data visualization.
components_strategy.tables: Compact data tables for transactions. Left-align numerical data, or right-align monetary values.
components_strategy.badges: Use soft pastel backgrounds with darker text for categories (e.g., bg-[#4A7C59]/10 text-[#4A7C59] for Income).

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly define hover text and bg colors (e.g., hover:bg-[#1F3B3B] hover:text-white).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors, transition-transform. NEVER use transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in/slide-up for dashboard widgets and transaction lists.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text). Do not use transparent backgrounds under text-heavy elements.
accessibility.focus_states: High contrast focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2A4F4F] focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, tabs) MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

empty_states_images.description: Illustration of wallet with money showing income growth
empty_states_images.placement: AI Insights empty state or positive milestone.

empty_states_images.description: Vivid illustration of wallet with coins

instructions_to_main_agent: PROJECT TYPE: This is a hybrid_fullstack React.js application (.js/.jsx files, NO .tsx). Use standard JavaScript syntax for Shadcn components.

FEATURES REQUIRED: JWT-based Login/Register, Dashboard (total balance, income/expense), Udhaar Tracker (Paise Lene Hai / Paise Dene Hai), Multi-account tracking, Charts (Recharts), Monthly Reports, and AI Insights.
COPYWRITING: Use Hindi/Hinglish terminology mixed with English (e.g., 'Udhaar Tracker', 'Paise Lene Hai (Receivables)', 'Kharcha (Expenses)') to make it culturally relevant and warm.
MULTI-CURRENCY: Default to INR (₹) throughout the UI. Allow an option/dropdown to switch to USD/EUR.

COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI primitives but rewrite them in standard .jsx if needed, or simply adapt the logic for .js. Do NOT use HTML-based native interactions (e.g., no <select>, use Shadcn Dropdown/Select).
DATA: Mock the backend logic, API responses, and JWT auth flow heavily. Clearly HIGHLIGHT 'MOCKED' in comments and UI if necessary.
AI INSIGHTS: Create a dedicated card or section using the 'Organic & Earthy' theme that simulates an LLM response analyzing the user's spending habits.
UDHAAR TRACKER: Implement specific visual indicators (green vs red/terracotta) for people you owe (Payables) vs people who owe you (Receivables). Include a 'Remind' button.
TESTING: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='add-transaction-btn').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT use generic purple/violet gradients or standard SaaS blue.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-colors).
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, not just heavy box-shadows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
